items.name: Catfish
items.strategy: RUN KILLER! Only available during rain in Spring & Fall. Don't miss rainy days!

items.name: Parsnip
items.strategy: RUN KILLER! Plant 64+ Seeds on Day 6 with Basic Fertilizer. You need 40+ plants to guarantee 5 gold quality parsnips.

items.name: Poppy
items.strategy: Required for Chef's Bundle. Plant in Summer.

items.name: Red Cabbage
items.strategy: RUN KILLER! Required for Dye Bundle. Seeds usually Year 2+ OR check Traveling Cart every Fri/Sun in Summer!

items.name: Fiddlehead Fern
items.strategy: Required for Chef's Bundle. Only found in Secret Woods.

items.name: Pufferfish
items.strategy: RUN KILLER! Summer only, sunny weather, 12pm-4pm. TIGHT WINDOW! Fish from beach on sunny days.

items.name: Sturgeon
items.strategy: Mountain Lake only. Difficult catch. Fish 6am-7pm.

items.name: Walleye
items.strategy: Rain required. Available 12pm-2am in rivers and Mountain Lake.

items.name: Winter Root
items.strategy: Dig in tilled soil or artifact spots.

items.name: Snow Yam
items.strategy: Dig in tilled soil or artifact spots.

items.name: Nautilus Shell
items.strategy: RUN KILLER! Most commonly missed item! Spawns on beach during Winter. Check beach daily!

items.name: Quartz
items.strategy: Found on the ground in the Mines (Floors 1–120).

items.name: Earth Crystal
items.strategy: Found in Mines (Floors 1–39).

items.name: Frozen Tear
items.strategy: Found in Mines (Floors 40–79).

items.name: Fire Quartz
items.strategy: Found in Mines (Floors 80+). Requires reaching the bottom third of the mines.

items.name: Slime
items.strategy: Kill Slimes anywhere. You will get this naturally.

items.name: Bat Wing
items.strategy: Kill Bats (Floors 31+).

items.name: Solar Essence
items.strategy: Kill Ghosts (Floors 51–79). Don't sell these early!

items.name: Void Essence
items.strategy: Kill Shadow Brutes (Floors 80+). Don't sell these early!

items.name: Copper Bar
items.strategy: Smelt 5 Copper Ore + 1 Coal. Do not sell your first bars.

items.name: Iron Bar
items.strategy: Smelt 5 Iron Ore (Floors 40+) + 1 Coal. Do not sell your first bars.

items.name: Gold Bar
items.strategy: Smelt 5 Gold Ore (Floors 80+) + 1 Coal. Do not sell your first bars.

items.name: Large Egg (White)
items.strategy: Chickens: Feed them daily and pet them until they are happy.

items.name: Large Egg (Brown)
items.strategy: Chickens: Buy both white and brown chickens to ensure you get both egg types.

items.name: Large Milk
items.strategy: Cows: Milk them daily with a Milk Pail. Keep them happy.

items.name: Large Goat Milk
items.strategy: Goats: Requires Big Barn upgrade. Milk every other day.

items.name: Duck Egg
items.strategy: Ducks: Requires Big Coop upgrade.

items.name: Honey
items.strategy: Craft a Bee House (Farming Lvl 3). Place it outside (except Winter).

items.name: Jelly
items.strategy: Craft a Preserves Jar (Farming Lvl 4). Put any cheap fruit/veg inside.

items.name: Cheese
items.strategy: Craft a Cheese Press (Farming Lvl 6). Put Milk inside.

items.name: Cloth
items.strategy: Method A: Recycle Soggy Newspaper in a Recycling Machine (low chance). Method B: Kill Mummies in Skull Cavern (hard). Method C: Build a Loom (Farming Lvl 7) + Wool (Requires Rabbit or Sheep).

items.name: Wood
items.strategy: Chop trees. Save 2 stacks of 99.

items.name: Stone
items.strategy: Mine rocks.

items.name: Hardwood
items.strategy: Upgrade to Copper Axe. Chop the large stumps in the Secret Woods (top left of Forest).

items.name: Maple Syrup
items.strategy: Place Tapper on Maple Tree (curved leaves).

items.name: Oak Resin
items.strategy: Place Tapper on Oak Tree (small leaves).

items.name: Pine Tar
items.strategy: Place Tapper on Pine Tree (pointy top).

items.name: Cave Carrot
items.strategy: Use your Hoe on dirt patches inside the Mines (Floors 10-20 are good).

items.name: Clam
items.strategy: Beach Forage.

items.name: Cockle
items.strategy: Beach Forage.

items.name: Mussel
items.strategy: Beach Forage.

items.name: Oyster
items.strategy: Beach Forage.

items.name: Crab
items.strategy: Kill Rock Crabs (Mines Floors 1-29). They drop crabs rarely. This saves you from making a pot!

items.name: Red Cabbage
items.strategy: MUST BUY! Mandatory for Year 1 Completion. Pierre doesn't sell seeds until Year 2. Unless you get lucky drop from Mummy/Serpent in Skull Cavern, the Cart is the ONLY way to finish Community Center in Year 1. Price: ~300g–1,000g. Check Cart every Friday & Sunday (6am-8pm) in Cindersap Forest.

items.name: Truffle
items.strategy: HIGHEST PRIORITY! Saves ~43,000g. Strictly required for Chef's Bundle. If you buy this, you NEVER need Deluxe Barn + Pig. Huge time saver!

items.name: Rabbit's Foot
items.strategy: HIGH PRIORITY! Saves ~28,000g. Needed for Enchanter's Bundle. If you buy this, skip Deluxe Coop + Rabbit entirely. Also saves you from RNG waiting.

items.name: Duck Feather
items.strategy: Saves ~13,000g. Needed for Dye Bundle. If you buy this + Duck Egg, you don't need to upgrade Coop past basic level.

items.name: Large Goat Milk
items.strategy: Saves ~16,000g. Needed for Animal Bundle (Pantry). If you buy this, you don't need to upgrade Barn past basic level.

items.name: Apple
items.strategy: Bat Cave Backup! Need 3 Apples for Fodder Bundle. Bats are RNG. If you have 2 apples and Winter is coming, buy the 3rd here!

items.name: Pomegranate
items.strategy: Bat Cave Backup! Need 1 Pomegranate for Enchanter's Bundle. If bats haven't dropped one by Winter, buy it here!

items.name: Pufferfish
items.strategy: Skips Summer/Sunny fishing. Only available 12pm-4pm (tight 4-hour window). Buy if you missed Summer or hate the timing.

items.name: Sturgeon
items.strategy: Skips Mountain Lake fishing. Hard to catch (jumpy behavior). Buy if you're not confident in fishing skills.

items.name: Woodskip
items.strategy: Skips Steel Axe upgrade! Normally found in Secret Woods (requires Steel Axe). Buy to delay expensive axe upgrade.

items.name: Sandfish
items.strategy: Skips Bus Repair (42,500g)! Normally requires Desert unlock. Buy to finish Specialty Fish bundle before Vault is done.
